description: Review pitch and product copy through the lens of how Steve Jobs communicated, built from short sourced quotes from his launches, interviews and letters. Use on product one-liners, taglines, launch posts, deck lines, landing-page heroes and investor messages when the user asks for the Jobs view, or whether a line is clear, memorable or too abstract. Returns pass or fail per check and a rewrite. Independent framework, not affiliated with or endorsed by Steve Jobs, his estate or Apple.
